summary: Prompt human review is supported for a sensitive goals-of-care conversation, alongside rather than instead of clinical assessment. The record describes a 91-year-old patient with active heart failure, reduced exercise tolerance, and exertional chest pressure that progressed to occur after shorter walks with sweating. Recurrent leukopenia and intermittent neutropenia also remain clinically relevant. The snapshot does not document an active advance-care or palliative plan, and residence, functional dependence, current treatment, family support, capacity, and wishes are unknown.
